Maine stands on the v4-improved TreeMap

All 16 Maine counties: TreeMap 2022 repaired with the v4 recipe, a hole model refit on Maine, LETO v1 cellular-automata stands, a speckle cleanup after LETO, and the LETO Maine riparian split. 1,035,735 management units over 17.05M forest acres.

Method 01

Six steps, county by county where memory needs it

01
Grid inputs
Maine grid on TreeMap's lattice; LANDFIRE hole strata, Harris ownership, Hansen loss warped onto it
02
Hole model
AlphaEarth Stage A/B refit on Maine strata; 72 Earth Engine tiles scored
03
v4 raster
county_improvement per county, stitched; dated stand age; young-plot IDs
04
FIA
COND/TREE rows for every plot the raster references (ME, MA, NH, NY)
05
LETO
Stage 1 attributes, CA, force_merge; speckle cleanup; riparian split; donor weights
06
Merge
statewide GeoPackage, donor weights, QA
v4 here is bookends only. The v4 rule is bookends_or_obata_and_hansen; Obata covers only one Florida Landsat scene, so obata & hansen is empty in Maine. Hansen still runs and dates the add-back pixels. The EVT gate v3 and the quarry patch rule apply as in FL5.

Layer · young plots 04

58% of add-back acres have no young FIA plot to match

ADR 0003 gives each add-back pixel a new ID with a dated age and a young FIA plot from LETO Maine's states (ME, MA, NH, NY). TreeMap holds few young plots there, so unmatched pixels keep their neighbour plot (UnmatchedYoungPlotPolicy.KEEP_NEIGHBOUR).

Neighbour-kept acres carry a young age with mature structure. Their STAND_AGE_2022 is dated (Hansen 208,312 ac, stratum median 113,171 ac) but BA, QMD and TPA are the mature neighbour's. The forest-type group map is southern: white pine and hemlock fall in other.

Layer · parent stands 06

The speckle cleanup removes 318,880 LETO stands under 5 ac

LETO's force_merge only joins a small stand to a same-owner neighbour. Harris's 10 m ownership, warped to 30 m, leaves single-pixel owners, so LETO keeps 709,216 parents. pipeline/stand_speckle.py then joins every stand under 5 ac that touches another to the neighbour it shares the longest edge with.

Closing 09

What the Maine layer establishes, and what it does not

  • A statewide v4 stand layer exists: 390,336 parents, 1,035,735 management units, 2,972 donor plots, every forest acre accounted (MU acres = forest cells).
  • Hole models are regional: the FL fit passes nothing; the Maine refit adds back 66,813 ac more than the FL-model run.
  • The speckle cleanup is a separate post-LETO step; LETO's labels are kept beside it.
  • Young structure is thin: 185,249 add-back acres carry mature structure under a young age.
Open: an owner policy for 5.97M unknown acres; isolated forest islands under 5 ac (keep, LETO's 60 m proximity merge, or drop); EVT gate v3 blocks only warm-temperate pasture (7997); NHDPlus HR HU4 NHDFlowline stands in for v1's NetworkNHDFlowline; Obata is pending outside Florida.
